name: Hamstr Manual
summary: Install and use Hamstr: the manual, with a live compose.yaml generator.
description:
The manual for Hamstr, the personal app platform: install it on a box or in Home Assistant, give it a domain and HTTPS, set up sign-in, and use apps and grains.

It includes a live compose.yaml generator that builds a file for your own setup (home network, own domain, behind a proxy, or a names service) in the browser, plus references for every setting, ports, data and backups, and security.

Everything is static: it runs from the app's own bundle and works offline.
